notes.title: Biomes & Day/Night cycles
notes.notes: [p][/p][p][b]Biomes[/b][/p][p]In our game, the enemy can pull you into their reality (biome) — a twisted version of the battlefield. Each mission has its own distinct theme, like a confrontation with King Paimon… or Andras.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Day phase[/b][/p][p]Standard mission structure: move with your squad, clear buildings, complete objectives.[/p][p]Focus on positioning, cover, and tactical movement.[/p][p]It’s a military op — clean and direct.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Night phase[/b][/p][p]Same map[/p][p]Enemies shift[/p][p]Terrain mutates. Tactical challenge: unstable ground, unpredictable threats, altered mission flow. [/p][p]Sometimes, you're pulled into their version of the battlefield — twisted, hostile, wrong. [/p][p]Survival becomes the only goal. [/p][p]Day is the mission. notes.title: Assault Soldier
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611908/4212cbae601041b98b1f857b6795376694062b4e.gif[/img]

In Echo Bastion, two core gameplay mechanics—on-deploy and on-kill abilities—play a critical role in shaping tactical decisions and combat outcomes.

On-deploy abilities activate the moment a unit is placed on the battlefield. These effects can include healing allies, damaging enemies, or granting temporary buffs to other units. This mechanic rewards thoughtful deployment, as timing and positioning can significantly influence the flow of battle.

On-kill abilities trigger when a unit defeats an enemy. These effects often grant benefits such as bonus attacks, health restoration, stat boosts, or even summoning additional units. The mechanic encourages aggressive, calculated plays and rewards efficient elimination of enemy forces.

Together, these mechanics create deep strategic possibilities and powerful synergies. Players must carefully consider not just what they deploy, but when and how to maximize the impact of every move. This adds layers of depth to the gameplay, ensuring each encounter feels dynamic, deliberate, and consequential.


--David & Lukas
